title: GAM-Integration-Debugger Input
description: Input payload for diagnosing Google Ad Manager GPT integration issues.

issue_description.description: Publisher-reported symptom. Examples: 'ads not rendering', 'blank slot', 'console error on load'.

html_js_snippet.description: The GPT JavaScript and/or HTML ad slot markup to be analyzed. May include <script> tags, googletag API calls, and <div> slot containers.

console_errors.description: Optional. Browser console output captured during the ad failure. Paste raw error strings including stack traces if available.

examples.issue_description: Ads not rendering on page load
